label: zai-dead-socket-fix-apr15
context:
Fixed Z.AI dead socket freeze bug in run_agent.py. Two patches applied:

1. Stale timeout hard cap at 120s (was 300s for 100K+ context). Lines ~5553-5564.
2. Socket liveness detector: every 30s checks select()+recv(MSG_PEEK) on underlying TCP socket. If keepalive killed it (EOF/error), immediately kills connection + reconnects. Lines ~5566-5659.

Root cause: at training gym context sizes (100K+), stale timeout scaled to 300s. Z.AI drops connection → keepalive detects dead socket at ~75s → but nothing checked socket state → session froze for 5+ minutes.

world_model_r27.py is built but the OTHER CLI hung testing it. Module itself is fine (confirmed working in isolated test). The hang was the Z.AI connection dying mid-response, not the Python code.

Training gym state: R25+R26 complete, 24 wired modules, 3650 plugin lines, 325 tips, Elo max 2273. R27 (world_model_r27.py) built but NOT yet wired into plugin. Next step after restart: wire R27 into distillation plugin hooks, continue R28+.
